pagination.correspondence_cursor: Optional exact next_cursor object with occurred_at and id from correspondence_page
pagination.stage_history_cursor: Optional exact next_cursor mutation_order string from stage_history_page
pagination.response: Independent correspondence_page and stage_history_page each contain total, has_more, and next_cursor. Append only the requested history array.
pagination.ordering: Correspondence by occurred_at then id descending. Stage history by mutation_order descending.

writes.stage: update-lead (base_version, stage_review evidence IDs, same idempotency key on retry)
writes.undo: update-lead (latest exact undo_event_id and prior stage)
writes.claim: claim-lead (authenticated human, unowned New, exact base_version)
writes.link: link-lead-client (exact client_id, confirmed human choice, exact base_version)
writes.engagement: set-prospect-engagement-status (client_id, client base_version, active or inactive, reason, expected_actor, same idempotency key on retry)

coverage.correspondence: captured_entries_only; zero captures do not imply zero communication; Details exposes stored original entry
coverage.search_run: last_search_at null until CARR has an authoritative new-lead search completion field
coverage.scores: existing record score; null shown as missing

prospect_lifecycle: Inactive prospects remain eligible Leads despite retained exact client and deal links. Active prospects return to the existing deal board.
